database.name: active_account_present
database.query: SELECT count(*) FROM identity.accounts WHERE account_id = '019bc186-de00-7101-8101-010101010101' AND status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL

database.name: pending_outbox_present
database.query: SELECT count(*) FROM platform.outbox_messages WHERE destination = 'fx-ops-local' AND published_at IS NULL AND attempt_count = 0

database.name: completed_deletion_history_present
database.query: SELECT count(*) FROM platform.deletion_requests WHERE deletion_request_id = '019bc186-de00-7a0a-8a0a-0a0a0a0a0a0a' AND subject_id = '019bc186-de00-7202-8202-020202020202' AND status = 'completed' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL

database.name: logical_tombstone_present
database.query: SELECT count(*) FROM platform.deletion_tombstones WHERE subject_type = 'account' AND subject_fingerprint = 'a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1'

database.name: deleted_active_account_absent
database.query: SELECT count(*) FROM identity.accounts WHERE account_id = '019bc186-de00-7202-8202-020202020202'

database_fingerprint.name: migration
database_fingerprint.query: SELECT version_num FROM alembic_version ORDER BY version_num

database_fingerprint.name: accounts
database_fingerprint.query: SELECT concat_ws('|', account_id::text, status, security_version::text, session_version::text, version::text, to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'), to_char(security_last_activity_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'), COALESCE(to_char(deleted_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'), 'NULL')) FROM identity.accounts WHERE account_id IN ('019bc186-de00-7101-8101-010101010101', '019bc186-de00-7202-8202-020202020202') ORDER BY account_id

database_fingerprint.name: domain_events
database_fingerprint.query: SELECT concat_ws('|', event_id::text, event_type, aggregate_id::text, aggregate_version::text, privacy_class, policy_versions::text, payload::text) FROM platform.domain_events WHERE event_id = '019bc186-de00-7303-8303-030303030303' ORDER BY event_id

database_fingerprint.name: outbox
database_fingerprint.query: SELECT concat_ws('|', outbox_id::text, event_id::text, destination, attempt_count::text, COALESCE(published_at::text, 'NULL')) FROM platform.outbox_messages WHERE outbox_id = '019bc186-de00-7707-8707-070707070707' ORDER BY outbox_id

database_fingerprint.name: deletion_history
database_fingerprint.query: SELECT concat_ws('|', deletion_request_id::text, subject_type, subject_id::text, status, policy_revision_id::text) FROM platform.deletion_requests WHERE subject_id = '019bc186-de00-7202-8202-020202020202' ORDER BY deletion_request_id

database_fingerprint.name: tombstones
database_fingerprint.query: SELECT concat_ws('|', tombstone_id::text, subject_type, subject_fingerprint, policy_revision_id::text, purged_scopes::text) FROM platform.deletion_tombstones WHERE tombstone_id = '019bc186-de00-7808-8808-080808080808' ORDER BY tombstone_id
